topic: How to Open a Brokerage Account
subtopic: Broker Background Checks and Form CRS
source_evidence: Before opening an account with any broker, you should always remember to read the firm’s relationship summary (Form CRS) and check the broker's background and disciplinary history.
answer: Before opening a brokerage account, read the firm’s relationship summary, called Form CRS, and check the broker’s background and disciplinary history. These are two separate steps to take as you evaluate a broker. The source points readers to its “How to Select an Investment Professional” bulletin for guidance on finding background and disciplinary information.
